recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow current-build source fix that completes the published FHIR-32381 intent across the search parameter surface while preserving the already-applied StructureDefinition semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-32381 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers change request for R5. It asked that QuestionnaireResponse.author avoid saying only a person could receive and record answers, that QuestionnaireResponse.source allow Device, and the accepted resolution added both Device and Organization as source while adding author/source guidance that Device is only appropriate when it directly determined the answers rather than merely serving as a capture tool.
initial_application: Commit 6d8abde43d00d13caff672213153f3cf9426174f and PR #1283 merge commit 6e63552ba58c6e4fdd4477a479d107d3df246bba applied the main StructureDefinition changes: author/source definitions now say individual or device, source allows Device and Organization, and both author and source include the requested Device/Provenance guidance. The active QuestionnaireResponse-source SearchParameter description still said only "The individual" provided the information.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, so the StructureDefinition and search parameter bundle are current-build inputs. Later FHIR-41407, already represented on the combined branch, added bounded Group support for QuestionnaireResponse.author and source, further confirming that the source search parameter description should not remain individual-only. Confluence SDC minutes on 2021-06-03 list FHIR-32381 as Persuasive with Modification; no relevant Zulip discussion was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml so QuestionnaireResponse-source now describes "The individual or entity" providing the information reflected in the questionnaire response.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml: changed the QuestionnaireResponse-source SearchParameter description from "The individual" to "The individual or entity".
